description.value: The official visitor centre for Destination Greater Victoria, situated in the heart of the Inner Harbour on Wharf Street. It serves as the city's primary trip-planning hub, offering local expertise, maps, and guidance across accommodations, tours, and outdoor activities in the Greater Victoria region. Touring cyclists stopping here can tap into the same resources used by visitors arriving by any mode, with the city's cycling-friendly downtown and accessible waterfront just outside the door.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack (20 spaces) at 13m; rack at 34m; rack (12 spaces) at 44m; stands (8 spaces) at 76m. Total: 40 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the official tourism visitor centre for Greater Victoria, located on Wharf Street at the Inner Harbour. The contact page shows the address as 812 Wharf Street, not 810 as in OSM, and provides a phone number (1-800-663-3883) absent from OSM. The website content covers regional tourism broadly but includes no specific mentions of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist amenities at the physical visitor centre itself, so all amenity fields remain null.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM has 810 Wharf Street; website contact page shows 812 Wharf Street Victoria B.C. V8W 1T3. Website value used as more authoritative.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, active tourism information office in the heart of Victoria's Inner Harbour; useful to touring cyclists for local maps, route recommendations, and regional trip planning.
